user.title: Local monthly bills
user.description: Bills stay in your Home Assistant. Currency is fixed for historical records.

record.title: Add / correct bill
record.description: Electricity: kWh; gas and water: m³. Use YYYY-MM. Payment month is not necessarily consumption month. This is not daily metering.

confirm.title: Confirm bill

delete_confirm.title: Confirm deletion
delete_confirm.description:
{summary}

Remove this bill and recalculate only Energy Ledger statistics. Other integrations are not modified.

error.invalid_amount: Enter a finite non-negative number without thousands separators.
error.invalid_period: Enter YYYY-MM within the last 120 months, not in the future.
error.unsupported_timezone: Timezone must use a whole-hour UTC offset.

abort.no_records: There are no bills to delete.
